blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of the Philippines (UP) Diliman on Monday called for the immediate release of 10 of its students and protesters arrested during demonstrations against the US-led Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s expected visit for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean Summit. “History teaches us that societies move forward not by silencing criticism but by listening to it,” the university said in a statement. The protesters, including farmers and members of Indigenous communities, held demonstrations at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila and Barangay Sucat in Muntinlupa City on Sunday, voicing concerns that the proposed […]...
